PASS - security review of #289
Head: 844d2fd697604ecbba1b489be3dd8d5a23d75741
Base: bc1ca834aa1163f86780f77bd83036f3b6b4e6ef

No exploitable vulnerability was found in the 16-file change, graded under
C33 and C34. This is a security verdict, not a claim that the local full gate
is green or that the PR has merged.

Trust prompt: crates/harnesses/src/trust.rs:151 recognizes whole option rows
after the heading, or before the final exact Claude footer when the heading
has scrolled away. Guidance and key selection at :102/:138 use the visible
highlight. The existing auto-answer path requires explicit trust_folder at
crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:1818 and targets the newly spawned pane at :1832,
not an identifier extracted from captured prose. The cwd guard at :1474
rejects control characters and multiline paths.

The recognizer is not dialog authentication: it does not require a contiguous,
unique, ordered menu, and a wholly fabricated screen can match. No external
attacker-controlled route to placing that screen over a different active
dialog was established. Arbitrary same-user pane/process control is trusted
under C33. Source tracing and a ten-case row model covered misleading prose,
missing/reversed anchors, absent highlight and simulated wrapped-path rows;
the later genuine default highlight wins in the supplied short capture.
The model is not compiled-parser or live malicious-directory proof.

Privacy: both new Claude captures were read completely. Manifest hashes and
byte counts matched (short: 199 bytes/12 rows; narrow: 544 bytes/30 rows).
No identified secrets, tokens, usernames or home paths. The narrow fixture
contains only a randomized temporary workspace path. Evidence:
crates/testkit/fixtures/harnesses/claude-2.1.329-folder-trust-short.txt:7-10,
claude-2.1.329-folder-trust-narrow.txt:3-23, and MANIFEST.toml:615.

Release hook: crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:1276 explicitly gates
admissions_in_flight with #[cfg(test)]; its caller is in
crates/daemon/src/compaction_wake_tests.rs:703. It is absent in ordinary
non-test release builds. This conclusion is source-based, not a release-symbol
inspection. with_stage_limit is separately compiled in production, but its
production default remains unchanged and its located use is the integration test.

Cost scope: no new production loop, poll, timer or launch site. The fallback
adds an in-process reverse scan of an already captured pane when its heading
is missing. Existing opted-in spawn answering may now proceed on a short pane;
existing capture is 50 ms per waiting spawn, with one-second key settling,
bounded by the registration deadline. No new steady-state per-seat activity
or live before/after measurement is claimed.

Validation:
- just pr-freeze 289: FINAL, twice; exact requested head, CLEAN, all five latest
  checks pass; detached review source remained clean.
- Exact-head CI run 44721998148: Node 22/24 typecheck, lint, tests, lockfile,
  native contracts and audit passed. Node 22: 14 config-check tests passed;
  110 Vitest files passed, two skipped.
- CI cargo nextest run --locked --workspace --profile ci: 2655 passed, six
  skipped; doctests, fmt and clippy passed.
- Local harness checks: exit 1. Rust, route inventory, smoke, pij-skill,
  Copilot native and SDK passed. Eight TS/tooling stages failed because this
  read-only checkout lacks pinned dependencies and used an incompatible
  ambient Biome; the trailer sensor warned. Local just typecheck confirmed
  missing Node type definitions (TS2688). C25: no dependencies installed or
  symlinked; TS proof is exact-head CI.
- Independent local trust-test build attempt: shared-lock timeout, exit 4;
  cargo never started. Std-only checker assertions (8), fixture checks and
  parser-row model assertions (10) passed; those are not Rust execution proof.

Harness feedback / magic wand: a read-only review gate should consume
exact-head CI receipts instead of prescribing dependency writes forbidden by
C25. Captured during this review; encoding is deferred outside the read-only
security scope.

Security/289 holding is retained until merge.
